title: kernel-sru-review: change task target from promote-to-proposed to sru-review
commit_message:
kernel-sru-review: change task target from promote-to-proposed to sru-review

Kernel trackers now have an explicit task called sru-review. It should happen before signing, which happens before promote-to-proposed. It is not approriate to do sru-review after signing-bot has completed signing. We must update kernel-sru-review script to perform sru-review when sru-review is in-progress/confirmed, as at promote-to-proposed it is too late, and signed binaries already happened.
